Check if a number is Prime & Even

A highly efficient Python function to solve this classic logic puzzle. Explore the code, understand the math, and test it live.

solution.py 
def is_prime_and_even(n):
    # The only even prime number is 2.
    # All other even numbers are divisible by 2.
    return n == 2

Why just n == 2?

You might expect a complex algorithm checking for factors, but math gives us a shortcut:

  • 1 Even Numbers: Any integer divisible by 2 (2, 4, 6, 8...).
  • 2 Prime Numbers: Numbers > 1 with only two factors: 1 and themselves.
  • 3 The Collision: 2 is the only number that satisfies both. Any even number greater than 2 is divisible by 2 (and 1, and itself), so it cannot be prime.

history_edu History Note

The concept of prime numbers dates back to ancient Greece (circa 300 BC). Euclid proved there are infinitely many primes.

code Optimization

Using n == 2 is an O(1) operation (constant time). A loop to check factors would be O(√n), which is much slower for large numbers.

warning Edge Cases

Negative numbers (like -2) are even but not prime. The number 1 is neither prime nor composite. 0 is even but not prime.
